what: Get an overview of land and building values in RS zones
title: Demo
code: search_cov_datasets("property-tax") |>   pull(dataset_id) |>   lapply(function(ds)     aggregate_cov_data(ds,                        group_by="tax_assessment_year as Year",                        where="zoning_district like 'RS-' or zoning_district like 'R1-1'",                        select="sum(current_land_value) as Land, sum(current_improvement_value) as Building")) |>    bind_rows() |>   # Records with no assessment year come back as their own group; drop them so   # the series is purely by year.   filter(!is.na(Year)) |>   mutate(Date=as.Date(paste0(as.integer(Year)-1,"-07-01"))) |>   pivot_longer(c("Land","Building")) |>   ggplot(aes(x=Date,y=value,color=name,group=name)) +   geom_point(shape=21) +   geom_line() +   scale_x_date(breaks=as.Date(paste0(seq(2005,2050,5),"-07-01")),date_labels="%b %Y") +   scale_y_continuous(labels=function(x)scales::dollar(x, scale=10^-9,suffix="Bn"),                      breaks=2^seq(0,10)*5*10^9,trans="log") +   labs(title="City of Vancouver RS/R1-1 zoned land and building values",        x=NULL, color=NULL, y="Aggregate value (nominal)") #> Downloading data from CoV Open Data portal #> Downloading data from CoV Open Data portal #> Downloading data from CoV Open Data portal #> Downloading data from CoV Open Data portal

code: plot_data <- property_polygons |>    left_join(tax_data |> group_by(tax_coord) |> summarize(current_land_value=sum(current_land_value)),by="tax_coord") |>   mutate(rlv=current_land_value/as.numeric(sf::st_area(geometry))) |>   mutate(rlvd=cut(rlv,breaks=c(-Inf,1000,2000,3000,4000,5000,7500,10000,25000,50000,Inf),                   labels=c("<$1k","$1k-$2k","$2k-$3k","$3k-$4k","$4k-$5k","$5k-$7.5k","$7.5k-$10k",                            "$10k-$25k","$25k-$50k",">$50k"),                   ordered_result = TRUE)) ggplot(plot_data) +   geom_sf(aes(fill=rlvd),color=NA) +   scale_fill_viridis_d(option="magma",na.value="darkgrey") +   labs(title="2026 assessment relative land values",fill="Value per m^2",caption="CoV Open Data") +   coord_sf(datum=NA)

title: Access the City of Vancouver Open Data API
text: VancouvR R wrapper around City Vancouver Open Data API. allows transparent reproducible access Vancouver Open Data Portal facilitate data analysis sharing code. package caches downloaded data duration current session, re-running code blocks result repeated downloads. speeds code, cuts unnecessary network traffic reduces strain City Vancouver Open Data infrastructure. title: Aggregate data from the Vancouver Open Data Portal — aggregate_cov_data
text: dataset_id Dataset id Vancouver Open Data catalogue select Aggregation expression using ODSQL syntax. Default `"count(*) count"`. group_by Grouping expression using ODSQL syntax. Default `NULL` (grouping). Filter expression using ODSQL syntax. Default `NULL` (filter). order_by Sort expression using ODSQL syntax, naming aggregate `select` field `group_by`, e.g. `"count DESC"`. Default `NULL`. refine Facet filter(s) form `"field:value"`; see [get_cov_data()]. Default `NULL`. exclude Facet exclusion(s) form `"field:value"`. Default `NULL`. limit Maximum number groups return. Default `NULL` returns groups. Ignored `group_by` `NULL`, always yields one row. apikey Vancouver Open Data API key, default `getOption("VancouverOpenDataApiKey")` refresh Bypass session cache re-download, default `FALSE`

what: Download a dataset from the Vancouver Open Data Portal — get_cov_data
title: Download a dataset from the Vancouver Open Data Portal — get_cov_data
text: Downloads dataset returns tibble `sf` object. `cast_types = TRUE` (default), field types looked via [get_cov_metadata()] columns automatically cast integer, numeric, Date. Datasets whose metadata declares `geo_shape` `geo_point_2d` field downloaded FlatGeobuf returned `sf` object coordinate reference system already set, rather CSV geometry re-parsed text. raw geometry fields part export, datasets come back single `geometry` column `geom` `geo_point_2d` column. Setting `cast_types = FALSE` `use_labels = TRUE` downloads CSV instead, returns plain tibble. Results cached duration R session, keyed query parameters. Re-running call trigger second download.

title: Download a dataset from the Vancouver Open Data Portal — get_cov_data
code: get_cov_data(   dataset_id,   select = "*",   where = NULL,   order_by = NULL,   refine = NULL,   exclude = NULL,   apikey = getOption("VancouverOpenDataApiKey"),   rows = NULL,   cast_types = TRUE,   use_labels = FALSE,   timezone = NULL,   refresh = FALSE,   ... )

title: Download a dataset from the Vancouver Open Data Portal — get_cov_data
text: dataset_id Dataset id Vancouver Open Data catalogue select Column selection / expression string using ODSQL syntax, e.g. `"current_land_value, land_coordinate coord"`. Default `"*"` returns columns. Filter expression using ODSQL syntax, e.g. `"tax_assessment_year='2024' zoning_district LIKE 'RS-'"`. Default `NULL` returns rows. order_by Sort expression using ODSQL syntax, e.g. `"height_m DESC"`. Default `NULL` leaves portal's ordering. refine Facet filter(s) form `"field:value"`, e.g. `"genus_name:ACER"`. Values must match facet exactly. Pass character vector apply several; multiple values field combined , different fields . Default `NULL`. exclude Facet exclusion(s), `"field:value"` form `refine`. Default `NULL`. apikey Vancouver Open Data API key, default `getOption("VancouverOpenDataApiKey")` rows Maximum number rows return. Default `NULL` returns rows. cast_types Logical; use metadata auto-cast column types download spatial datasets `sf`. Default `TRUE`. use_labels Logical; name columns using human-readable field labels instead API field names. Default `FALSE`. Setting `TRUE` disables type casting, metadata keyed API names. timezone Timezone used render datetime fields, e.g. `"America/Vancouver"`. Default `NULL` uses portal default (UTC). refresh Bypass session cache re-download, default `FALSE` ... Ignored; retained compatibility earlier versions

title: VancouvR 0.1.11
text: migrate deprecated Explore API v2 v2.1. portal flags every v2 request ods-explore-api-deprecation response header. aggregate_cov_data() longer uses /aggregates endpoint, removed v2.1 now returns HTTP 410. Grouped queries answered dataset export endpoint, longer capped 100 groups; ungrouped queries use records endpoint.

title: VancouvR 0.1.11
text: spatial datasets downloaded FlatGeobuf rather CSV geometry re-parsed text. geometry arrives coordinate reference system already set, columns arrive typed portal instead read character cast afterwards. FlatGeobuf export carry raw geometry fields, datasets now come back single geometry column longer geom geo_point_2d text columns beside . Set cast_types = FALSE download CSV instead. every function now fails gracefully: unreachable portal, refused request malformed query yields NULL warning rather error, script knitted document degrades instead stopping. Code relied error thrown test result NULL, turn warning back error: tryCatch(get_cov_data("..."), cov_api_warning = function(w) stop(conditionMessage(w))). get_cov_data() returns downloaded data even metadata lookup behind cast_types = TRUE fails; columns simply left character. aggregate_cov_data() now returns groups whose grouping key empty. old /aggregates endpoint omitted , silently dropped records: grouping property-tax-report tax_assessment_year, example, hid 6,009 records assessment year.

title: VancouvR 0.1.11
text: get_cov_facets() lists values facetted field takes, record counts, making easier discover field contains filtering . list_cov_facets() catalogue , listing themes, keywords, data owners data teams datasets filed , number datasets . features facet identifies 135 datasets carry geographic records, come back sf objects. list_cov_datasets() gained refine exclude, catalogue can filtered facet values, e.g. refine = "theme:Sustainability". get_cov_data() gained order_by, refine, exclude, use_labels timezone; aggregate_cov_data() gained order_by, refine, exclude limit. refine exclude accept character vector sent repeated parameters. list_cov_datasets() gained argument, catalogue can filtered portal instead download. API key now sent Authorization: Apikey header instead query parameter, longer appears request URLs, therefore server logs, proxies, error messages. requests fail HTTP 429 server error retried exponential backoff, honouring portal’s Retry-header. get_cov_rate_limit() reports daily request quota, package warns per session fewer 5% allowance remain. get_cov_data() now returns sf object datasets whose spatial field geo_point_2d, just geo_shape. requests identify VancouvR/<version> user agent.

title: VancouvR 0.1.11
text: search_cov_datasets() prints list similarly named datasets list non-empty. previously tested number columns rather number rows, search near matches printed empty tibble alongside warning. get_cov_data() warns unrecognised arguments passed ... instead ignoring silently. get_cov_metadata() reads field list top level response, v2.1 moved dataset.fields. v2.1 old path returned metadata, turn silently disabled column type casting sf conversion get_cov_data(). get_cov_data() longer fails outright date column parsed; warns returns column character, always intended. get_cov_data() sends documented limit export parameter instead undocumented rows alias, suppresses byte order mark v2.1 adds CSV exports default. failed requests report portal’s error_code message instead printing raw response body. get_cov_data() longer turns values overflow R’s 32-bit integer range NA. portal’s int type 64-bit, assessed land values exceed ; columns now returned doubles rather silently corrupted. get_cov_data() passes apikey argument metadata lookup behind cast_types = TRUE. lookup previously fell back option, explicit key ignored .

title: VancouvR 0.1.11
text: package now uses httr2 instead httr HTTP requests. httr superseded longer developed. Retries, query parameter encoding redaction API key printed requests now handled httr2 rather hand. session cache downloaded data unchanged. warning raised failed request classed, can caught selectively: cov_api_warning failure, cov_unreachable portal reached, one class per status code, e.g. cov_http_404. examples fetch bounded amount data now run, rather shown. remaining \dontrun{} examples download whole catalogue whole dataset. test suite now replays recorded API responses, runs offline CRAN instead skipping. Fixtures refreshed data-raw/record-fixtures.R. dropped urltools dependency; query parameters now assembled httr2, also fixes escaping ODSQL expressions. added inst/CITATION citation("VancouvR") reports current version.
